name: New York Striploin over Cauliflower Risotto with Mushrooms

cookwares.name: stainless steel or cast iron skillet

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
0.45 kg cremini mushrooms
1 ½ medium heads cauliflower
1 small pkg chives

instructions.primary_message: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, pat the steak dry with paper towels and place on a plate; season with salt and pepper on both sides.
instructions.secondary_message:
1.02 kg striploin (New York strip) steak
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Once the skillet is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Working in batches if necessary, add steak and cook until desired doneness, 2-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate and loosely cover with foil.
Preheat a large pot over medium-high heat.
Once the pot is hot, add butter and swirl to coat the bottom. Add onion and cook, stirring often, until softened, 3-4 minutes.
Slice mushrooms. Add to the pot with the onion; cook, stirring often, until soft and browned around the edges, 4-5 minutes.
Cut cauliflower heads into quarters, then trim off and discard leaves and thick stem. Using a box grater or food processor, coarsely grate cauliflower.
Add cauliflower, garlic, broth, salt, and pepper to the pot. Continue to cook, stirring often, until cauliflower has softened, 6-7 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
296 ml chicken or vegetable broth
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, finely grate Parmesan. Add Parmesan and cream to the pot with the cauliflower. Reduce heat to medium and cook, stirring often, until slightly thickened, 4-6 minutes. Remove from heat.
instructions.secondary_message:
43 g Parmesan cheese
177 ml heavy cream

instructions.primary_message: Mince chives. Thinly slice steak against the grain.
To serve, divide cauliflower risotto and steak between bowls or plates and garnish with chives. Enjoy!
